A **donor CRM with text messaging** is a donor management system that integrates SMS capabilities, allowing nonprofits to send and receive text messages directly within their donor database platform.

## Key Features

These integrated systems typically include:

- **Text-to-give functionality**: Supporters text keywords like "GIVE" or "DONATE" to a designated number and receive a link to complete donations on mobile[4][5]
- **Two-way texting**: Enable one-to-one conversations with donors to answer questions, share updates, and deepen relationships[2]
- **Bulk messaging**: Send segmented campaigns to specific donor groups (major donors, volunteers, event attendees) for updates, reminders, and appeals[4]
- **Personalization**: Customize messages with recipient names, giving amounts, and donor segments to strengthen connections[3]
- **Automated workflows**: Schedule messages, send automated reminders for pledges or events, and trigger responses based on donor actions[1][3]
- **Engagement tracking**: Monitor delivery rates, click rates, and text responses within a unified dashboard[3]
- **Integrated donor data**: All text activity and donations automatically record in your donor database, simplifying follow-up and stewardship[6]

## Popular Platforms

Nonprofits can use CRM systems like **DonorPerfect**, **Bloomerang**, **CharityEngine**, **Bonterra**, and **Andar/360**, which offer native texting tools or integrations. Many require connecting a Twilio account for SMS delivery[4].

## Strategic Uses

Organizations use donor CRM texting for event reminders, volunteer recruitment, pledge fulfillment reminders, thank-yous, real-time campaign updates, and time-sensitive appeals. Text messaging achieves high open rates—over 98% of texts are read within 3 minutes[5]—and performs best when combined with other channels like email and direct mail[7].
